svg.desc: Greater Cairo Metro Line 2 Projects LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2016 845 million EGP combined DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview The Cairo Metro Line 2 portfolio includes El Monib, Sakiat Mekky and El Attaba stations, together with Behoos, Massara, El Mazalat, Giza and Cairo University stations. Delivered for the National Authority for Tunnels with VINCI, the projects covered architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, project management and site supervision.
